text.tspan: Daily protein supply from animal and plant-based foods

text.tspan: Daily per capita protein supply is measured in grams per person per day. Protein of animal origin includes protein from all
meat commodities, eggs and dairy products, and fish & seafood.

tspan.tspan: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025)
The FAO apply a methodological change from the year 2010 onwards.
